Interface VirtualView

All Known Subinterfaces:
ClientHandler
All Known Implementing Classes:
SocketClientHandler, VirtualView.NoOp
public interface VirtualView
Server-side abstraction of a connected client. Implemented by RmiClientHandler and SocketClientHandler.

GameController holds one VirtualView per player and calls these methods to push notifications; each implementation serializes the call for its own transport.

The static constant NO_OP (and factory method noOp()) provide a silent no-operation implementation used during server-side game replay, so that the model can fire notifications without any real clients being connected.
